citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
Records of acquisition and disposition, environmental enhancement plan for birds, contingency plan and program of
veterinary care were not available for review during the inspection. The facility representative said he was busy dealing
with deliveries and did not have time to gather the paperwork.
Availability of records is of utmost importance to help USDA inspectors ensure compliance with the Animal Welfare Act
and its regulations. Good recordkeeping helps determine the quality of care and welfare given to the animals.
Documents and records that are required to be kept under the Animal Welfare Act (AWA) should be available at the time
of an inspection so the documents can be reviewed to determine the facility's compliance with the provisions of the AWA
Correct from this day of July 31, 2026 forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
